result.topic_en: Formulas 54–61 expressing integrals of functions of the elliptic quantities k, k', K (with respect to dq/q) as logarithmic series and Lambert-type series in q, followed by the start of a general theorem on rearranging the summation of a convergent series.
result.transcription:
54) $\int\left(\frac{2\sqrt{k'}K}{\pi}-1\right)\frac{dq}{q} = -\frac{4i}{2}\log\frac{1+q^{2i}}{1} + \frac{4}{6}\log(1+q^{6}) - \frac{4}{10}\log(1+q^{10}) + \frac{4}{14}\log(1+q^{14})$ [?]
$= -\frac{2i}{2}\log\frac{1-q^{2i}}{1+q^{2i}} + \frac{2i}{4}\log\frac{1-q^{4i}}{1+q^{4i}} - \frac{2i}{6}\log\frac{1-q^{6i}}{1+q^{6i}} + \frac{2i}{8}\log\frac{1-q^{8i}}{1+q^{8i}}$
ubi logarithmos ita sumendos esse manifestum est, ut evanescant
posito $q=0$
functiones eaedem ad dignitates ipsius $q$ evolutae [-hasce seriebus ex primum-]
adhibitis Cl. Jacobi denotationibus hoc modo repraesentantur
55) $\int_0 (\log k - \log 4\sqrt{q})\frac{dq}{q} = -4\sum\frac{e_p}{p^2}\left(q^p - \frac{3q^{2p}}{4} - \frac{3}{16}q^{4p} - \frac{3}{64}q^{8p} - \frac{3}{256}q^{16p} - \dots\right)$
56) $\int_0 -\log k'\frac{dq}{q} = 8\sum\frac{e_p}{p^2}q^p$
57) $\int_0 \log\frac{2K}{\pi}\frac{dq}{q} = 4\sum\frac{e_p}{p^2}\left(q^p - \frac{1}{2}q^{2p} - \frac{1}{4}q^{4p} - \frac{1}{8}q^{8p} - \frac{1}{16}q^{16p} - \dots\right)$
58) $\int_0\left(\frac{2K}{\pi}-1\right)\frac{dq}{q} = 4\sum\frac{\psi(n)\,q^{2(4m-1)^2 n}}{2(4m-1)^2 n}$
59) $\int_0\left(\frac{2kK}{\pi}\right)\frac{dq}{q} = 8\sum\frac{\psi(n)\,q^{\frac{(4m-1)^2 n}{2}}}{(4m-1)^2 n}$
60) $\int_0\left(\frac{2k'K}{\pi}-1\right)\frac{dq}{q} = -4\sum\frac{\psi(n)\,q^{(4m-1)^2 n}}{(4m-1)^2 n} + 4\sum\frac{\psi(n)\,q^{2^{l+1}(4m-1)^2 n}}{2^{l+1}(4m-1)^2 n}$
61) $\int_0\left(\frac{2\sqrt{k'}K}{\pi}-1\right)\frac{dq}{q} = -4\sum\frac{\psi(n)\,q^{2(4m-1)^2 n}}{2(4m-1)^2 n} + 4\sum\frac{\psi n\,q^{2^{l+2}(4m-1)^2 n}}{2^{l+2}(4m-1)^2 n}$
